The fix is complete. 

**Change**: `packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts:198` — added `if (id.type === "Identifier") bindings.add(id.name);` in `permuteHelperAST`, so the helper's entry-point name (e.g. `_set`) is treated as taken when resolving name conflicts for the helper's internal functions. Previously, when user code contained `let set`, the internal `set` function was renamed to `_set`, colliding with the helper's exported `_set` and producing infinite recursion.

**Verification**:
- Both issue reproductions (`transform-classes` and `transform-object-super`) now emit `__set` (internal) vs `_set` (entry point) instead of a self-recursive `_set`
- `babel-helpers` tests pass (including `declaration name conflict helper entrypoint`)
- `transform-classes` (223 tests), `transform-object-super`, `babel-core`, `transform-runtime`, `proposal-class-properties`, `helper-replace-supers`, `transform-destructuring`, `transform-private-methods`, `transform-async-to-generator`, `proposal-decorators`, `transform-object-rest-spread`, `transform-spread`, and `preset-env` all pass — the one preset-env failure (`_esmodules babel 7` stderr snapshot with a caniuse-lite warning) was confirmed pre-existing via `git stash`
